validation.tolerance_metric: divergence(a,b,peak) = |a-b| / max(|a|, |b|, 0.1*peak); per-feature pass: divergence ≤ 0.05; per-panel pass: > 80% of holds clear ALL features

translation_pattern: P10 (leak-relative scale check); single-gate voltage-gated K, no inactivation
key_observations: Single activation gate `m` only — no inactivation gate. Inward-rectifier signature: minf has a +30 mV shift inside the exponent argument, so it activates as V hyperpolarizes below va_kir-30.
Tau function is U-shaped: sum of two exponentials with opposite slopes (peak tau near v ~ p2tmkir).

NMODL annotates gbar units as `(nS/cm2)` — appears to be a documentation typo. Empirically gbar values are treated as S/cm² by NEURON's mechanism interpreter (matches the upstream `gScm2()` rescaling pipeline). Translation correctness validated post-hoc by 11/11 hold agreement.
use_case: Required for option α-1 CP3 AVA cell construction (4-channel set [IRK + LEAK + EGL19 + NCA] matching Nicoletti's AVAL).
